en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional emigration song. 'Пуста била' is rendered 'was desolate' (the 'била' is a reported-past form, roughly 'it turned out to be').

lines.en: America, a land of migrant labor.

lines.cyr: Кој отиде мамо, не се врати,
lines.lat: Koj otide mamo, ne se vrati,
lines.en: Whoever went, mother, did not return,

lines.cyr: кој се врати, мамо, се сакати.
lines.lat: koj se vrati, mamo, se sakati.
lines.en: whoever returned, mother, came back crippled.

lines.cyr: Кој без рака, мамо, кој без нога,
lines.lat: Koj bez raka, mamo, koj bez noga,
lines.en: Some without an arm, mother, some without a leg,

lines.cyr: мојто либе мамо и без глава.
lines.lat: mojto libe mamo i bez glava.
lines.en: my sweetheart, mother, even without a head.
